Metadata.Title: Ratchet and Clank
Metadata.Name: 1728p (PS4 Pro mode)
Metadata.Note: 3072x1728 render in PS4 Pro mode instead of 2560x1440, with 3840x2160 output. The game only allows these steps, so 1728p and 1872p replace 1620p and 1800p. Enable only one resolution entry.
Metadata.Author: gasb07

Metadata.Title: Ratchet and Clank
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS Unlock
Metadata.Note: Unlocks the 30 fps cap. Works alone or with any resolution entry. 60 FPS patch by illusion.
Metadata.Author: illusion

Metadata.Title: Ratchet and Clank
Metadata.Name: 120 FPS Unlock
Metadata.Note: Runs the game above 60 fps, up to 120 fps depending on the scene and resolution. The manager turns on the 120 Hz video output when you enable it, and your TV or monitor must accept 120 Hz. Works alone or with any resolution entry. Based on the 60 FPS patch by illusion. Only one frame rate entry can be on at a time.
Metadata.Author: illusion
